# Homestyler

> Free cloud-based 3D home design software with 1M+ furniture models, AI-powered rendering, and VR/AR visualization for homeowners, designers, real estate, and brands.

Homestyler is a comprehensive design platform originating from Autodesk that combines professional-grade 3D design tools with accessibility for consumers. It serves multiple user segments through specialized solutions including floor planning, custom furniture design, virtual staging, and e-commerce product visualization, supported by cloud rendering and a marketplace of design assets.

## Key Topics

- 3D home design
- Cloud rendering
- Floor planning
- VR/AR visualization
- Product visualization
- Interior design
- Virtual staging
- 3D modeling
- Furniture library
- Design collaboration
- Mobile design app
- Photorealistic rendering
- Custom furniture design
- E-commerce integration
- Design templates

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [Free 3D Home Design Software | 1M+ Models & Cloud Rendering - Homestyler](https://www.homestyler.com): Homestyler homepage: free 3D design with 1M+ furniture models and cloud rendering
- [Interior Design Software: An All-in-one 3D Tools for Designers | Homestyler originated from Autodesk](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/for_designer): Homestyler interior design solution for professional designers with VR and cloud rendering
- [Free home renovation design software | Homestyler](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/for_homeowners): Free home renovation planning with 3D visualization and AR furniture placement
- [Free Floor Plan Creator Online | Design & Generate 2D/3D Floor Plans Instantly - Homestyler originated from Autodesk](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/design_floor-planner): Free online floor plan creator with 2D/3D design, real-time collaboration, 4K rendering

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Homestyler Real Estate Solutions: 3D Virtual Staging & Property Design Software](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/for_real-estate): Real estate solution: 3D virtual staging, floor plans, and photorealistic renders
- [Homestyler for Brands & Retailers](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/for_brands-retailers): B2B solution for brands and retailers: 3D product visualization and virtual showrooms
- [Homestyler for Schools & Universities](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/for_school): Educational solution for architecture and interior design learning with VR/AR

## Design Tools & Features

- [Homestyler Custom Furniture Solutions: 3D Design Tool for Bespoke Furniture & Room Layouts](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/design_custom-furniture): Custom furniture design tool with bespoke kitchen cabinets and VR visualization
- [Homestyler Team License](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/design_team-license): Team collaboration license for design studios with shared workspace and permissions
- [Room design app, Homestyler interior home design app free](https://www.homestyler.com/room-design-app): Mobile app for iOS and Android: free 3D room design with furniture catalog
- [3D Home Design Material Marketplace: Free/Paid Professional Interior Design Templates and Empty Room Templates](https://www.homestyler.com/asset-market): Marketplace for free and paid design templates and room layouts for interior design

## Visualization & Rendering Services

- [VR & AR Technology](https://www.homestyler.com/solution/visualization_VR-AR-Technology): VR and AR technology for immersive interior design visualization and virtual tours
